purpose: Exploratory convolutional-token accuracy study. A local convolutional encoder preserves radiographic structure before matched fidelity or dot attention. Existing frozen experiments remain unchanged.
selection: No hyperparameter grid. Run three validation-only seeds, then freeze this exact paired design before test inference.
claim_boundary: Accuracy gains belong to the hybrid architecture. Fidelity-specific benefit requires superiority to the identical dot-kernel control. This is not a quantum-advantage or novelty claim.
